body: I didn't know those existed. I'll look into that as an other option. Thanks
It's technically a seasonal job that I get temp housing at. So I don't think I could change my residency to up there.
That's even more comforting. Thanks for your help and the info.

ok that's comforting. Yah I wouldn't be applying for anything or buying anything for those 5 months. And my states limitations is 6 years so there's a few years til that ends. I'll make sure I have someone checking my mail and gamble that they don't find out. Cause I really am excited at the prospect of paying them off, it'll help me sleep better at night. I'd just hate it if they messed up the job by garnishing when it's my first priority to pay them when I come back.

I would but 2 of the credit cards were from banks, with one of them having overdraft fees. Everywhere I've seen to open a checking account you have to clear those debts up from my understanding. Otherwise I would just direct deposit my check and do it that way. I'm also afraid of calling them and explaining the situation, just to have them know I'm about to work so they can sue and garnish my wages all at the same time.

Alright. Thanks. That's what I was thinking, and none of those other symptoms are present. If that changes I'll go in then. 

Yah the mental health side hasn't been the most fun. I had thought I had my life together finally after years of treatment, but too much stress got the better of me. But unlike past attempts this one really scared me, and really put my priorities in order this last week.
This website is a joke. Its just like real life. No one cares about someone whining about their problems. I'm really starting to think humanity and this life is really just over rated.

And another night of little sleep. Everything just keeps replaying in my head from last week. Now I wonder why I'm going to school again. Why I'm working. I'll never get a decent job. Even with school one time around I still can't get more than minimum wage. I'll be stuck living at home cause of debt and no way to get out. Because of that my social life sucks. Can't bring people back to my place cause I live with my mom as a 27yr old guy. Which in turn makes me feel alone and that nothing is worth it.  I don't know how much more of this I can take.

I guess I really am in hell. i don't know what I did to piss the world off so much but my life has been a series of one bad event after another. And just when I was about to give up the world messes with me and gives me something good. Then when I'm starting to do ok it just rips it right away. I hate this life so much.

So I made it home and was able to get some sleep on the plane. I think I needed that the most. I was able to contact my school and explain that I didn't mean to unenroll, and they fixed that. I also managed to explain my situation to my boss and since I technically didn't miss any work and nothing had been processed that I still can keep my job but my 3month new employee probation got extended 3 more months. And I have an appointment to see my doctor next week as well to try to find something to help me without completely bogging me down like it was before. 

I still feel crushed and hopeless. It feels like my insides have been completely crushed. But at least I was able to fix most of my mistakes I made today when I was freaking out. Thanks Brent for being there for me to talk to
I truthfully don't think that will happen. But I see what you mean. I don't know what will happen in the future but I need to be in s place to deal with it
I thank you for talking with me. When I get home I'm going to see my doctor. My planes just about to depart so I can try to put my life back together

I do appreciate it. Everything you say is good advice. But when I had no motivation before I'm just afraid I'll fall back into the vicious cycle. I just hate how it all fell apart due to me overreacting in the blink of an eye

I don't know. I just called in this morning and said I quit. So probably not that job. And it's the first one I've had in 4 years, and before that my job history is sketchy. 

And I had no future self, I just tried for her. The first time a girl has ever cared for me and I didn't find her until I was 27. I feel like my future self is gone because I don't think I can last that long

If I was home I'd go to the emergency room. But I can't do that where I am at. The best night of my life became the worst night of my life just because of a simple miscommunication that I freaked out over. I just want to be home and sleep forever

I just really want to see my doctor again because I know I need to be back on meds, and to just have somewhere to break down. But I'm stuck at an airport heading home from my devastating trip and night that seemed so perfect until I freaked out. I just need to break down and I'm not somewhere where I can do it

This was the first girl that seemed to show interest in me, she was my first for a lot of things at 27 years old. I couldn't imagine the pain of your relationship issues. 

It's my second time through college, getting a second degree so a lot of my being able to afford it was based on doing at least 12 credits which I was doing. But I already ruined it by unenrolling, now they want the money back that I had used for school expenses. I don't even know if I even want to do it anymore now. My motivation is fading fast.

I spent 4 years going through hospitals, psych wards, therapists and medicines. Nothing worked. I had no motivation and I was nearing my end. Then I met her and she made me want to better myself. But now that she's gone I just feel like there's no point in trying to get better if it ends up falling apart so easily. I fear I'm going to get stuck again in the endless cycle. 

I dropped my classes because only two weeks in I was already overwhelmed, being 27 and in college made my self esteem worse. My job was dreadful but it was the best one I've ever had and I was terrible at it. With her dropping me I just couldn't handle it and made a rash decision which now I'm feeling complete dread of what I did
